## Verification

- Canonical readiness evidence: `docs/evidence/changes/<change-id>/scorecard.md`

- Documentation impact evidence: `docs/evidence/changes/<change-id>/documentation-impact.md`
- Machine-readable documentation impact: `docs/evidence/changes/<change-id>/documentation-impact.json`
- Risk tier / release score:

- [ ] Cross-platform CI passed
- [ ] Security and dependency review passed
- [ ] Documentation build passed
- [ ] Documentation synchronization decision is `ready`

- [ ] Package archive smoke test passed
- [ ] Checksums attached
- [ ] Upgrade and rollback guidance verified
- [ ] Machine-readable release scorecard attached
- [ ] Required architecture, security, privacy, accessibility, performance, reliability, testing, documentation, developer-experience, open-source, enterprise-readiness, debt, and gap assessments completed
- [ ] Roadmap reconciled as completed, deferred, rejected, discovered, deprecated, or retired
- [ ] Waivers are approved and unexpired
- [ ] Canonical Release Ready decision is recorded with approvers
- [ ] Every active domain meets the risk-tier minimum
- [ ] No mandatory blocker is triggered
